variables.Fs: mean bounded spectral flux between adjacent L1-normalized magnitude spectra
variables.Di: mean spectral flatness (geometric/arithmetic magnitude ratio); operational interference/noise-density proxy
variables.Cs: 1 - mean normalized spectral entropy; spectral concentration/coherence proxy
variables.Dcog: legacy symbol retained for traceability; onset-interval dispersion proxy CV/(1+CV), not a direct measurement of human cognition

phi_S: Phi_S = 1 - weighted mean_j min(|x_j - median_baseline_j|/(k*robust_scale_j),1), equal weights, k=3; robust_scale=max(1.4826*MAD,IQR/1.349,0.01)
sampling: first half of non-overlapping 4-s windows per source defines source-specific clean baseline; second half is held out and reused only to generate paired controlled perturbations

OneClassSVM.preprocess: StandardScaler fit only on clean baseline windows

validity_boundary: This experiment evaluates a bounded acoustic operationalization and controlled perturbation sensitivity. The primary analysis preserves the two signals reported in the submitted manuscript; five additional KXTXR audio objects are a secondary within-corpus robustness check. It does not establish universal MIHM validity, human cognitive measurement, multimodal validity, or general sociotechnical performance.
legacy_note: The submitted Phi=0.5000 values are preserved as historical R0 outputs. R1 replaces the legacy near-constant jump-potential estimator with the explicit baseline-proximity Phi_S and regenerates all inferential results.
